schemaVersion.description: 1.1 khi run mang templateSelection/intentEnvelope (plan 34). 1.0 = run legacy, hiểu là lab/explicit theo field template.

brief.description: Natural-language description of the Mini App. Null means neutral demo shell.

miniAppId.description: Resolved Mini App ID. Always a string, exact-preserved (leading zeros kept). Never invented by the SKILL.

appIdSource.description: Where miniAppId was resolved from per the §5.2 precedence.

variant.description: Template data variant selected from brief classification. Với template.source=official, giá trị bị bỏ qua (giữ cho backward compat).

template.description: Nguồn scaffold. Vắng mặt = lab template (backward compat với run cũ).

id.description: lab: 'lab-template'; official: id trong config.json officialTemplates.catalog; existing: 'existing-app' (--existing, không scaffold)

revision.description: Official template immutable commit SHA (or legacy ref). Omitted for lab/existing apps without pinned provenance.

invokedVia.description: Host adapter surface that produced this invocation. Contract is identical across adapters.

capabilities.description: Explicit capabilities composed after base-template selection. V1 supports checkout on the lab template.

checkoutMode.description: Checkout execution mode. simulator keeps all mock behavior in the desktop harness; demo-cod compiles a visibly labelled, client-only COD order demo that may be deployed to Development for UI feedback but never represents a paid transaction.

templateSelection.description: Kết quả ranker. Vắng mặt = run legacy trước plan 34.

intentEnvelope.description: Envelope đã validate; giữ để truy vết vì sao chọn template.
